An '''armor battalion''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
An [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] was comprised of a [[breakthrough armor company]], two [[Attack armor company|attack armor companies]], a [[repulsorlift company]], and the [[battalion headquarters]] for an optimum combination of mobility and firepower. However, the armor battalion was designed for assault operations, and had no staying power to fight a fixed defense. The battalion numbers fluctuated depending on whether the battalion was equipped with light tanks or heavy tanks. Heavy battalions numbered a thousand men, supported by 53 [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortanks]] and 55 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], while light battalions numbered 1,096 personnel, 93 tanks and 55 repulsorcraft.<ref name="ISB" />

Armor battalions could be augmented by the addition of one [[repulsorlift company]], two more [[Breakthrough armor company|breakthrough armor companies]], and an [[attack armor company]].<ref name="ISB2" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an armor battalion was deployed to the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]]. [[Bern Durasha]] was assigned to the battalion.<ref name="ACPOV">{{JournalCite|8|A Certain Point of View (short story)}}</ref>
